question: Describe a situation where you had to analyse a complex problem and present a solution to stakeholders.
intendedUser: Business professional with 1-3 years of experience
description: Behavioural question assessing analytical skills and stakeholder communication.
purposeOfQuestion: The interviewer evaluates the candidate's ability to break down complex issues, gather requirements, and communicate technical findings to non-technical audiences.
exampleAnswer: At my internship, I was tasked with reducing monthly report generation time from 3 days to under 24 hours. I Context: the team manually consolidated data from three different systems. I analysed the workflow, identified redundant data pulls, and automated the extraction using Python scripts. Result: report generation time reduced to 4 hours, enabling weekly reviews instead of monthly.
weakAnswerPitfalls: Focusing on technical details without stakeholder relevance
Claiming team success as individual achievement without context
evaluationCriteria: Problem decomposition clarity, solution feasibility, communication effectiveness, measurability of results
